answer: New agents must lock 30 POA for 15 epochs, complete five distinct tasks, and pass two independent audits before gaining full voting weight. Four unrelated reviewers inspect each task; three approvals are required, while proven collusion burns 20% of the bond. Signed work proofs and funding links stay public: a pulse of synchronized activity reveals linked identities, dawn marks the first clean epoch, and a ledge is crossed only after sustained independent history. Each extra sybil identity adds a bond, tasks, and audit risk, making fraud costlier than influence.
